name: _footer.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  preferences/_footer.scss — dialog footer + done button, and the pref-fade enter/leave transition classes.
//  Imported by preferences.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.pref-footer {
  padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-2xl);
  border-top: to-rem(1) solid var(--border-color);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

// Done/close button at the bottom.
.pref-done-btn {
  @extend %RESETBTN;
  @extend .ttl-xs;

  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-2xl); // taller + wider for all lang labels
  min-width: to-rem(160); // never squishes in DE/PT/ES
  margin-top: to-rem($space-lg); // breathing room above
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: transparent;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: to-rem(1);
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition:
    color 0.2s ease,
    opacity 0.2s ease;

  // Animated corner borders (same style & animation as Check Out button)
  &::before,
  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: to-rem($space-md);
    height: to-rem($space-md);
    transition:
      width 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      height 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  &::before {
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    border-top: to-rem(1) solid var(--text-primary);
    border-left: to-rem(1) solid var(--text-primary);
  }

  &::after {
    bottom: 0;
    right: 0;
    border-bottom: to-rem(1) solid var(--text-primary);
    border-right: to-rem(1) solid var(--text-primary);
  }

  &:hover,
  &:focus {
    color: var(--text-primary);
    opacity: 0.85;

    &::before,
    &::after {
      width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-2xs)});
      height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-2xs)});
    }
  }
}

// Vue modal transition
.pref-fade-enter-active,
.pref-fade-leave-active {
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
}
.pref-fade-enter-active .pref-dialog,
.pref-fade-leave-active .pref-dialog {
  transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}
.pref-fade-enter-from,
.pref-fade-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
}
.pref-fade-enter-from .pref-dialog,
.pref-fade-leave-to .pref-dialog {
  transform: scale(0.94);
}
